notes:
Only the first card entry symbol, EggHandOver-v0 (dexterous_gym.envs.egg_hand_over:EggHandOver), is served; the other four card entry symbols (BlockHandOver, PenHandOver, EggCatchUnderarm and BlockCatchUnderarm) are NOT COVERED. The fake backend is a pure Python analytic kinematic stand-in: it never imports the clone, gym or MuJoCo, models no rigid-body dynamics, contacts, actuators, sensors or noise, and was not compared with the upstream MuJoCo environment (gym 0.15.3 and mujoco_py were not installed and were not run). The non-listed sim backend, which would call gym.make on the real environment, was not run. The fake returns the Gymnasium 5-tuple and applies the registered 75-step truncation itself; the upstream class is legacy Gym (step returns a 4-tuple, done always False) and the bridge's legacy fallback is exercised on reset and seed. The 40 ms timestep is the model timestep 0.002 s (egg_handover.xml:4) times the default 20 substeps (two_hands_env.py:20). The gate passed with the bridge's expected warnings: G6.NO_NATIVE_CALL for cap.world.seed.v1 (it only sets the seed of the next reset) and G8.NO_UNIT for the bridge-derived inputs ticks, the reset and seed inputs, and action.values. No G4 warnings. No hardware was attached and no hardware backend was run; this package is model-authored (deepseek-v4.1-flash:1017, run wP-063) and unreviewed. No operator-required bound exists, so there is no site-limits.example.json.
